verdict.rationale: The docs describe a built-in skill creator that interviews the user about what a skill does, when it should trigger, and whether it should include scripts. A recorder can also draft a reusable skill from a demonstrated workflow. For packaging, the built-in `@plugin-creator` skill scaffolds the `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest and a local marketplace entry for testing. Missing for 10: evidence of guidance on improving or iterating on existing skills, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the creator tools.
